tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background for docs and site.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, admonitions, sidebars on surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Code blocks and output cells.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on any surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, metadata, taglines; 4.5:1 on surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline rules, table lines, card edges (decorative, not control borders).

tokens.name: fur
tokens.usage: The bear's fill, sampled from the logo. Identity colour for large fills, cover blocks and illustration; same in both themes. Never text or a text ground for muted text.

tokens.name: fur-tint
tokens.usage: Soft warm panels behind hero content and callouts; ink text on it.

tokens.name: logo-ink
tokens.usage: The logo's outline and wordmark black. Only inside logo artwork; use ink for UI text.

tokens.name: espresso
tokens.usage: Brand colour: links, primary buttons, focus rings, solid bands, code strings, the first series in plots. Dark brown in light, latte in dark; on-espresso text on it.

tokens.name: on-espresso
tokens.usage: Text and icons on espresso fills.

tokens.name: espresso-tint
tokens.usage: Selected rows, current nav item, note boxes, soft fills; ink or espresso text on it.

tokens.name: honey
tokens.usage: Warm gold accent fill: second plot series, step markers, highlight badges. Always dark text (ink in light, on-espresso in dark) on it; never text itself.

tokens.name: honey-ink
tokens.usage: Honey as small text (version tags, kickers, code keywords) on surface, surface-sunken and fur-tint.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, deprecation warnings and destructive actions only.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inline gaps, icon-to-label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Control padding, list item gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, paragraph spacing.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing, page gutters.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inline code, badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and admonitions; the largest radius.
